ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a schematic diagram of the distribution of public bicycle rental points in a certain area of Weifang City. It can be seen that the rental points are marked with dots of different sizes and are distributed along urban roads, blocks, and near main roads. Next to it there is a legend explaining main roads, secondary roads, branch roads, as well as large and small rental points. Then reason: The question stem asks, “Weifang City implements a public bicycle rental system mainly in order to alleviate what urban problem?” The related purposes listed in the original question include alleviating traffic congestion, advocating low-carbon travel, reducing automobile exhaust emissions, etc. Among them, the “urban problem that needs to be alleviated” corresponds to the problem of urban traffic congestion; low-carbon travel is a mode of travel, and automobile exhaust emissions are an environmental emissions problem. Therefore the answer is traffic congestion.
